svg.title: Coordinated corner opening rewind on both inhabited floor plates and the north roof section
svg.desc: Sixteen corner bays shift away from the four exterior corners. The fridge changes hinge and the principal bed turns ninety degrees. The section compares the existing and raised ordinary north crown.

g.text: Move the corner openings on both storeys
Ochre = old centre · Green = proposed aperture · Solid bars = new jambs · North up

An upper-only move would leave a full
205 mm jamb over the ground opening.
reverse its hinge. Principal · rotate the
complete bed, then park it 775 west
NORTH ORDINARY SECTION · X4700 or X7300
The hips, valleys and ceiling must join
this ordinary section on the same house.
